newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet differentials steady in light talk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet differentials steady in light talk.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials were steady in light talk on Tuesday afternoon that saw bids and offers in a very subdued New York Harbor (NYH) market move farther apart, traders said.
In NYH, bids on 54-grade dropped notionally by about 0.25 cent to 1.25 cent over, while offers remained steady at 1.75 cents over, traders said.

At the U.S. Gulf Coast, prompt airline-quality 54-grade material was said to be doable at 0.90 cent under June NYMEX heating oil futures. Bids and offers stood at 0.75 and 1.00 cent under respectively.
((-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1633))
